# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Quarterly O(1) rebel-guarded fallback pulse for Slot 84 (oe_dis_).
# Deduplicated per calendar month via global_var:oe_dis_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now so BYZ never double-ticks.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_dis_fallback_pulse
		oe_dis_human_synergy_pulse
	}
}

oe_dis_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
		NOT = { global_var:oe_dis_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		current_year >= 1440
		current_year <= 1765
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 4
			current_month = 7
			current_month = 10
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dis_init }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = VEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } tag = GEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } tag = FRA }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:FRA } tag = HAB }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:FRA } NOT = { country_exists = c:HAB } tag = TUR }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:FRA } NOT = { country_exists = c:HAB } NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR } tag = CHI }
			AND = { is_ai = no }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_dis_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}

# Lightweight semiannual human-only synergy & 1750 milestone sync (works for every playable non-BYZ nation).
oe_dis_human_synergy_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
		current_year >= 1440
		current_year <= 1765
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 7
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
	}
}
